name: Pen-Draw Title
easing: icon: EASE.inOut cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1) f0-26; title wipe: same f14-46; subtitle: EASE.out (0.22,1,0.36,1) f46-62
bestFor: Opening a topic or chapter: 'Real World or Benchmark?', 'Let's talk about X'.
notSuitable: Lists, comparisons, anything needing more than one headline.
keyframeTable: icon 45% drawn (top of scales + beam), title not started
icon fully drawn orange; title wipe 22%, nib dot at left of title
title 70% revealed, orange nib dot at wipe edge
title complete, nib gone, subtitle 25% visible, 12px below rest
rest: icon (960,300) 190px, title centered baseline y600, subtitle baseline y700
script: f0-26: the orange icon is pen-drawn stroke by stroke (stroke-dashoffset 1->0).
f14-46: the title is revealed left-to-right by a clip wipe; an orange dot (the pen nib, r=10) rides the wipe edge.
f46-62: subtitle fades in and rises 16px.

params.title: string, <=45 chars, auto-fits to 1612 px (96px max, never below fit)
params.subtitle: string <=60 chars
params.icon: key of ICONS (scales, play, chip, browser, check, cube, bolt, star, search, warn)

footprint: icon 190x190 + title <=1612 wide x ~100 tall + subtitle = ~1200x520 px centered (62% x 48%)
colorRules: Icon orange (the single orange focal). Title/subtitle cream. No blue.

callouts.text: orange nib rides the wipe edge
